item.title: Drake’s ‘ICEMAN’ Scores Third Week Atop Billboard 200
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the Billboard Breakdown, your weekly dose of music news and chart-topping updates. I'm your host, and today we're diving into the latest from the Billboard 200.
[Music transitions]
Host: Drake is still riding high, folks. His album "ICEMAN" spends its third week at number one, earning 171,000 equivalent album units in the US. That's down 24% from last week, but still a impressive showing. This milestone marks one of five Drake albums to spend at least three weeks at the top spot, and his first since "Certified Lover Boy" in 2021.
[Short music clip]
Host: But Drake isn't the only one making waves. Paul McCartney just debuted at number five with his new album "The Boys of Dungeon Lane", scoring his 22nd top 10 album. That's a remarkable feat, and we're excited to see what this new music brings. The album's first-week sales were boosted by 18 physical variants, including over 10 vinyl editions.
[Music transitions]
Host: Rounding out the top 10, we have aespa's "LEMONADE" arriving at number nine, and a trio of former number ones from Ella Langley, Morgan Wallen, and Noah Kahan. Michael Jackson's "Thriller" and "Number Ones" also made the cut, with Wallen's "One Thing at a Time" climbing to number eight.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's Billboard Breakdown. Be sure to check out the full chart on Billboard's website on June 9, and follow @billboard and @billboardcharts for the latest updates. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
